canonical_identity.title: ELR-1000
canonical_identity.scope: Multilingual endangered/low-resource Indic multimodal recipe dataset; Mundari is explicitly one of ten listed languages.

canonicalization.rule: GitHub repository, Hugging Face dataset presentation, parquet shards, images and audio are manifestations/components of one ELR-1000 dataset identity unless provenance establishes independently citable source identities.
canonicalization.count_warning: Provider-wide totals MUST NOT be interpreted as Mundari-specific totals or MMSC audited-source counts.

promotion_gates: verify exact dataset licence and redistribution terms
verify contributor/speaker consent, privacy and culturally sensitive content handling
obtain permitted immutable bytes and SHA-256 for promoted artifacts
record record-level stable locators and media/time locators
separate recipe/text assertions from participant-derived linguistic/cultural evidence
rights_note: No reuse permission inferred from public discoverability. Exact licence must be checked before redistribution or evidence materialization.
cultural_uncertainty: Mundari inclusion is verified; no cultural proposition is inferred from dataset-level metadata.
